source.title: 神很遠，神很近｜天國語言極簡史
source.description: A narrative theological popular-knowledge book about divine language, creation, Babel, incarnation, Pentecost, the Spirit and new creation.

bookIntent.thesis: 神的語言原本已經賜給了人，因著人的驕傲過犯，神收回了祂那有創造力的語言，再藉著道成肉身的贖回，由聖靈送回我們這份恩賜。
bookIntent.audience: general Chinese readers, including readers without formal theological training
bookIntent.visualTone: Westside literary-theological; restrained, beautiful, historically grounded, low-temperature surface with high interior tension

development.targetForm: theological popular-knowledge novel / narrative theological nonfiction book
